thread:
eva_marketing: Quick thread — topic shortlist for next webinar. Two high-level names: 'Pragmatic Inference: Serving LLMs at Product Scale' or 'Cost‑Effective Inference Patterns for Real Apps'. I'm leaning toward Pragmatic Inference (more tactical). Speakers proposed: Liam (Product), Jay (Infra), Nora (Ops). Date idea: Wed Apr 27, 45m talk + 15m Q&A. Need run-of-show/invite flow + rehearsal plan. Thoughts?

liam_product: Leaning Pragmatic too. Want to make sure we have 2-3 concrete takeaways (batching, cache, routing policies) — marketing can spin a checklist in the follow-up.

sam_sdr: Love it. Add a tiny customer case (anonymized) that shows cost delta. That helps sales follow-up.

jay_engineering: I can do a 10m mini-demo: live routing fallback (hosted -> dedicated -> private). Will need a safe demo key + small dataset. Can we use staging.ibm-demo?

nora_ops: Rehearsals: we should block 60m for a full run two days before, plus a tech-check 30m on the day. Ops will need to provision a rehearsal VPC and confirm access.

olivia_ops: I'll set up the calendar invites. Proposed rehearsal windows: Mon Apr 25 10:00-11:00 or Tue Apr 26 15:00-16:00 PT. Which works for speakers?

liam_product: Tue 26 afternoon works best for me.

jay_engineering: Tue 26 works. Need to coordinate with infra — @deploy-bot can you spin up the rehearsal env (tiny GPU) and share endpoint?

deploy-bot: Rehearsal env request received. Provisioning tiny-gpu-01 in staging, will post endpoint and demo creds when ready. ETA ~ 40m. :gear:

eva_marketing: Run-of-show draft (keep it tight):
```
- 00:00 Intro + context (5m) — Eva
- 05:00 Product roadmaps & customer outcomes (10m) — Liam
- 15:00 Serving architecture + routing demo (10m) — Jay
- 25:00 Ops & reliability + canary/fallbacks (10m) — Nora
- 35:00 Benchmark highlights + cost playbook (5m) — Marketing quick hits
- 40:00 Panel recap + 5 quick takeaways (5m)
- 45:00 Live Q&A (15m)
```

nora_ops: That looks good. Add a slide that lists failover order and SLA expectations — helps ops questions.

sam_sdr: For invite flow, can we include a 2-step nurture: initial invite with 3 bullets (what you’ll learn), then a reminder with a one-slide TL;DR + CTA to request a demo? Also set UTM params for tracking.

olivia_ops: I'll create the invite sequence in Braze and add UTM params. Need the 3 bullets and 1-slide TL;DR by Fri Apr 15.

liam_product: I'll draft the 3 bullets and the TL;DR slide by Thu Apr 14.

eva_marketing: Speakers slide deadline = Apr 15 EOD. Marketing will assemble the landing page + registration form (short form, company + role + use-case). We'll include a checkbox to opt into a technical follow-up.

sam_sdr: For lead routing: MQLs -> SDR queue if company size < 500, otherwise route to AE. Add tag for 'webinar-demo-request' if they check follow-up.

jay_engineering: Small note for demo: I'll use a canned prompt set and show token/latency numbers. Please keep the prompt list public in the slide notes so we can reproduce.

eva_marketing: Agreed. Marketing will publish a short benchmark table on the page (latency @ 128 tokens, cost per 1k tokens, tail p95). Keep numbers rounded.

nora_ops: Ops checklist for rehearsal: 1) staging endpoint URL 2) demo creds + scope 3) screen-share verify 4) fallback switch control 5) run-of-show copy. I'll DM the checklist to speakers.

olivia_ops: Calendar invites sent for Tue Apr 26 15:00 PT rehearsal and Wed Apr 27 09:30 PT tech-check. (links in invite)

eva_marketing: Promo plan: 2 emails, 2 LinkedIn posts, one blog summary + short promo video clip. Will need 3 quote lines from each speaker for social.

liam_product: I'll send 3 quote lines by Mon Apr 11.

sam_sdr: Also create a short one-question poll in the registration flow: 'Which is your biggest inference painpoint?' (latency / cost / reliability / scale) — helps follow-ups.

eva_marketing: Good call. Olivia, can you make sure the form supports that field?

olivia_ops: Yep. Added as a required question.

deploy-bot: Rehearsal env up: https://staging-infer.redwood.test/demo (creds in DM). Ensure demo script uses small model and limited tokens.

jay_engineering: Got it. Thanks. I'll rehearse with the staging endpoint tomorrow.

eva_marketing: Final checklist summary: slides by Apr 15, rehearsal Tue Apr 26 15:00 PT, tech-check Wed Apr 27 09:30 PT, landing page + reg live by Apr 20. Any blockers?

sam_sdr: No blockers from SDR side. :thumbsup:

liam_product: None here. :raised_hands:

nora_ops: Ops ready pending final slide + DMed checklist.

eva_marketing: Great — I'll consolidate notes and send the updated run-of-show and promo timeline after this. Thanks team! :sparkles:
